findings.trigger: Finite initial yield, root still running, notify_on_exit=False/default and no later poll/stop/shutdown.
findings.impact: Advertised hard deadline has no independently scheduled owner; no observed runaway claimed.
findings.smallest_options: Always-owned deadline task or one mandatory process-lifetime watcher with optional notification consumer; watcher does not drain foreground output.
findings.consequences: Preserve stdin proof, root/tree distinction, failed-kill/unknown ownership and raw output; broader public result/output choices remain D6/D7.

findings.trigger: External filesystem/store-health change denies second approved-input revalidation after native reservation, before spawn/session cleanup owns it.
findings.impact: Unlaunched durable starting row can survive, become conservative unknown after restart, block activation or consume bounded capacity; no new authority.
findings.smallest_options: Scoped reservation owner immediately after reservation, covering every prelaunch return/exception, with explicit transfer to spawn/session ownership.
findings.consequences: Cancel only proven-unlaunched reservations; retain uncertain launched effects and exact snapshots/revalidation. Preserve 88acd736c2 input guards.

findings.confidence: high in source mechanism; contention unmeasured
findings.trigger: Manager start/cleanup awaits spawn/readiness/kill under global lock.
findings.impact: Independent operations serialize for those waits; eight-session bounded workload may justify retaining lock.
findings.smallest_options: Retain lock, or separately narrow with explicit pending slots, capacity accounting, closed/cancellation rollback and failed cleanup reinsertion.
findings.consequences: Adds state; deadline/cleanup corrections first. No measured benefit, copied eviction/capacity policy or silent unknown-effect reclamation (D7).
